page.layout: One page of text, centred; running head "EPISTOLA" above the text; a narrow strip of show-through from the facing page at the right edge (not transcribed).

main_text.p: rore incitatus, prodit innocentem Christum: sicut de eo Scriptura testatur, Sathanas intrauit in eum. Quamobrem statuamus, omnes eos mancipia & domicilia diabolica esse, qui in peccatis contra legem Dei & agnitam veritatem studiose perseuerarant. Præterea, si quis odiose loquatur de aliorum factis, aut aliter interpretetur quàm ab altero sunt suscepta, tantum ut ipse aliquid esse uidea tur, proximusque despiciatur: certò illum cōcludamus à dæmone agitari. Idem iudicium potest fieri de reliquis peccatis, quæ sunt contra singula Decalogi præcepta, quorū Paulus quædam in specie recenset Gal.5. 1 Cor.5.6. Ephef.4.

At hoc in loco quærere aliquis posset, quæ sit causa tanti odij, tantæq; inimicitiæ malorum spirituum contra Ecclesiam: & quare mali genis, non simili à Deo recipiantur modo, sicut homines? Ad hæc sic respōdetur: Summus ille princeps malorum

page.notes: Printed text is partly damaged by a dark spot near "quæ sit"; words there read with caution. The first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The ornamented "tæq;" and "ꝑ"-type abbreviations are copied as printed. Show-through from the facing page is at the right edge and omitted.
